title: crypt + b2: 400 sha mismatch
body:
I'm using rclone 1.33 on Linux x64, trying to upload a local file to Backblaze B2 using the new Crypt remote type.

Here are the errors I'm getting:

```
$ cat ~/.rclone.conf
[b2-plaintext]
type = b2
account = ...
key = ...
endpoint = 

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2-plaintext:spiffytech-work
filename_encryption = off
password = ...
password2 = ...

$ echo "stuff" > test.txt

$ rclone -v copy test.txt b2-plaintext:spiffytech-work                                                                                                                                                                                       
2016/08/25 16:01:47 rclone: Version "v1.33" starting with parameters ["rclone" "-v" "copy" "test.txt" "b2-plaintext:spiffytech-work"]
```
